title: Slope profile with scoped infinite-slope stability model
description: Reusable SVG slope geometry component with a clearly stated planar infinite-slope force model using normal soil thickness, cohesion, friction angle, unit weight, and a pore-pressure ratio.
learningObjectives: Relate slope rise/run to inclination and slope length.
Evaluate a simplified planar infinite-slope factor of safety while distinguishing it from circular-slip or full limit-equilibrium analysis.

verification.notes: Rebuilt as a real Three.js terrain wedge with a scoped planar infinite-slope slice; independent rendered comparison pending.
